qe: What is 'Fiscal Deficit'?
qh: 'राजकोषीय घाटा' (Fiscal Deficit) क्या है?
o: Total Exp - (Revenue Receipts + Non-debt Capital Receipts)
e: RajkoshIya ghata (Fiscal Deficit) ki sahi paribhasha hai kul vyay mein se rajasy praptiyan tatha karz-rahit punji praptiyan ghatana, isliye teesri vyakhya theek baithti hai. Iske nikaalne ka maqsad yah hai ki sarkar apne kharch ko kitne karz se poora kar rahi hai, iska pata chale; isliye ismein karz wali punji praptiyan nahi jodti, kyonki wahi to ghata ka karan hai. Sarkar ka kul karz, kul vyay mein se kul praptiyan ghatana tatha rajasy vyay mein se rajasy praptiyan ghatana - ye teeno baatein ghata ke khaas matlab nahi hain, isliye wo teeno vikalp galat hain. Exam point: Fiscal Deficit = kul vyay - (rajasy praptiyan + gair-karz punji praptiyan); yah sarkar ke karz lene ke rujhaan ko dikhata hai.

qe: Who presents the Union Budget in the Parliament?
qh: संसद में केंद्रीय बजट कौन पेश करता है?
e: Kendriya budget sansad mein vitta mantri prastut karte hain, isliye doosra vikalp sahi hai. Yah riwayat isliye najar aayi ki aam janta ka saara paisa kharch karne ka hisaab chune hue pratinidhiyon ke saamne rakha jaye; isliye aarthik sarvekshan ke ek din baad budget pesh hota hai, iske baad sansad mein bahes tatha manzuri hoti hai, aur tabhi sarkar apna kharch shuru kar sakti hai. RBI gavarnar, pradhan mantri tatha rashtrapati is kaam ko nahi karte, isliye wo teeno theek nahi hain. Exam point: kendriya budget sansad mein vitta mantri pesh karte hain - yahi sarkar ke aay-kharch ka saalana lekhajokha hai.

qe: In Bihar, where is the 'Export Promotion Industrial Park' (EPIP) located?
qh: बिहार में 'निर्यात संवर्धन औद्योगिक पार्क' (EPIP) कहाँ स्थित है?
e: Bihar mein niryat sanvardhan audyogik park (EPIP) Hajipur mein sthit hai, isliye teesra vikalp sahi hai. Yah park isliye banaya gaya ki bihar se niryaat hone wali cheezon ke nirmata ek jagah par saanjhi suvidha, bhandaran tatha karz payein; isliye yahan makhana, litchi tatha anya krishi utpadon ke processing tatha packing ki ek jagah payi jaati hai, jisse udyogon ko bhaiye sthan ki tulna mein sasti zameen tatha suvidha milti hai. Barauni, Muzaffarpur tatha Patna bhi bihar ke bade sheher hain par EPIP Hajipur mein hai, isliye wo teeno vikalp galat hain. Exam point: EPIP Hajipur mein hai - yahi bihar ke niryat tatha khane-peene ke udyog ka kendra hai.

qe: In Bihar Budget 2024-25, what is 'Social Sector' expenditure priority?
qh: बिहार बजट 2024-25 में 'सामाजिक क्षेत्र' के खर्च की प्राथमिकता क्या है?
e: Bihar budget 2024-25 mein sabse badi prathmikta shiksha, sehat tatha samajik kalyan par kharch ki hai, isliye doosra vikalp sahi hai. Yah jor isliye diya jaata hai ki bihar ki aabadi tezi se badh rahi hai tatha desh mein sabse kam prati vyakti aay yahin hai; isliye padhai tatha swasthya par kharch karne se hi aage udyog tatha rozgar banane wale kaam karne yogya log milte hain. Koi nahi, keval khanan tatha keval sadkein wale vikalp is tarj par nahi hain, isliye wo teeno theek nahi hain. Exam point: bihar budget ki prathmikta samajik kshetra yani shiksha, sehat tatha kalyan hai - yahi manav punji banane ka kharch hai.

qe: In Bihar, where is the 'Food Park' being established under Mega Food Park scheme?
qh: बिहार में 'मेगा फूड पार्क' योजना के तहत फूड पार्क कहाँ स्थापित किया जा रहा है?
e: Bihar mein mega food park Khagaria mein banaya ja raha hai, isliye pehla vikalp sahi hai. Yah park isliye khada kiya ja raha hai ki bihar ka anaj, aalu tatha doodh khapat se zyada paida hota hai par ushe sambhalne tatha bechne ki suvidha kam thi; isliye yahan bajar, thanda bhandaran tatha process karne ki ek jagah ban rahi hai, jisse kisaan ko apni fasal ka sahi daam milta hai. Munger, Jehanabad tatha Patna mein anya park tatha sansthaen hain par yah park Khagaria mein hai, isliye wo teeno vikalp galat hain. Exam point: mega food park Khagaria mein banaya ja raha hai - yahi bihar ki khet ki cheezon ko sambhalne ka kendra hai.

qe: What is the 'Fiscal Deficit' target recommended by the NK Singh Committee for Center by 2023 (as a goal)?
qh: NK सिंह समिति ने 2023 तक केंद्र के लिए 'राजकोषीय घाटा' का क्या लक्ष्य अनुशंसित किया था?
e: NK Singh samiti ne 2023 se aage ke liye kendriya rajkoshiya ghata ka lakshya 2.5 pratishat tay karne ki salah di thi, isliye teesra vikalp sahi hai. Yah sujhav isliye diya gaya ki pehle ke varshon mein sarkar 3 pratishat tak ghata rakhti thi tatha gareeb deshon mein uchh karz se byaj ka bojh badh jaata hai; isliye samiti ne karz ko 60 pratishat tak laane ke liye chhote samay mein 3 pratishat tatha uske baad 2.5 pratishat ka rasta sujhaya. Paanch pratishat, koi nahi tatha teen pratishat wale vikalp is samiti ke sujhav ke sahi aakde nahi hain, isliye wo teeno galat hain. Exam point: NK Singh samiti ne 2.5 pratishat wale rajkoshiya ghata ka lakshya diya tha - yahi FRBM sudhar samiti ki salah thi.

qe: In Bihar Budget, what is 'Committed Expenditure'?
qh: बिहार बजट में 'प्रतिबद्ध व्यय' (Committed Expenditure) क्या है?
o: Mandatory expenses like Salaries, Pensions and Interest
e: Pratibaddh vyay yani committed expenditure ve kharch hote hain jo har haal mein karne hi padte hain - jaise vetan, pension tatha karz par byaj, isliye pehla vikalp sahi hai. Yah bhag isliye sabse pehle dekhna zaroori hai ki sarkar ki aay ka kitna hissa to pehle hi bandha hua hai; isliye ismein kam jagah bachne par naye kaam tatha yojnaon ke liye bahut kam paisa bachta hai, isliye bihar jaise rajya ke liye yah sankhya bahut ahem ho jaati hai. Janta ke liye tohfe tatha naye kaam par kharch - in dono ke saath koi nahi bhi sahi nahi hai. Exam point: pratibaddh vyay vetan, pension tatha byaj jaise jaruri kharch hote hain - yahi sarkar ki majboori wala kharch hai.

qe: Who was the 'Chairman' of the 14th Finance Commission?
qh: 14वें वित्त आयोग के 'अध्यक्ष' कौन थे?
e: Chaudahve vitt aayog ke adhyaksh Y.V. Reddy the, isliye pehla vikalp sahi hai. Yah aayog isliye banayi gayi thi ki kendriya sarkar tatha rajyon ke beech tatha rajyon ke apne aap mein kar ki aay ka batwara tay ho; isliye isne apni salah mein rajyon ka hissa badhaya tatha gramin suvidhaon par jor diya, jisse bihar jaise rajya ko zyada paisa mila. Koi nahi, N.K. Singh tatha Vijay Kelkar baad tatha pichhle aayogon se jude naam hain, isliye wo teeno vikalp galat hain. Exam point: 14vin vitt aayog ke adhyaksh Y.V. Reddy the - yahi badhate batwara tatha gramin suvidhaon ki salah ke liye jaani jaati hai.

qe: What is 'Effective Revenue Deficit' (ERD)?
qh: 'प्रभावी राजस्व घाटा' (ERD) क्या है?
o: Revenue Deficit minus Grants for Capital Assets
e: Prabhavi rajasy ghata (ERD) nikalne ke liye rajasy ghata mein se punji sampatti ke liye mili anudaan ghatayi jaati hai, isliye teesra vikalp sahi hai. Yah aankda isliye nikala jaata hai ki anudaan se mila paisa naye kaam (punji) par lagta hai tatha aay ka saadhaaran kharch nahi hai; isliye us anudaan ko joda na jaaye to rajya ka asli ghata zyada bhayankar dikhta hai, tatha sarkar ki karz ki asli zarurat samajh mein aati hai. Keval kar ka nuksan, koi nahi tatha kul karz - in teeno ka yah matlab nahi hai. Exam point: prabhavi rajasy ghata rajasy ghata mein se punji sampattion ki anudaan ghata kar nikala jaata hai - yah sarkar ke asli ghata ka aankda hai.

qe: In the Bihar Budget, what is 'Revenue Surplus' primarily used for?
qh: बिहार बजट में 'राजस्व अधिशेष' का मुख्य रूप से किसलिए उपयोग होता है?
e: Bihar ke budget mein rajasy adhishthit (surplus) ka istemal mukhya roop se punji kharch par hota hai, isliye doosra vikalp sahi hai. Yah tareeka isliye apnaya jaata hai ki rajya ko bhavishya ke liye sadkein, bijli tatha school banane ke liye paisa chahiye tatha naye karz se byaj ka bojh nahi badhana hai; isliye bachaya hua paisa seedhe naye kaam par lagta hai, jisse aage aay badhti hai. Purane karz chukana, koi nahi tatha videshi yaatraayein - ye sab alag cheezein hain. Exam point: rajasy adhishthit ka paisa punji kharch par lagta hai - isse sarkar bina naya karz naye kaam banati hai.

qe: Who presented the 'Economic Survey 2023-24' of Bihar?
qh: बिहार का 'आर्थिक सर्वेक्षण 2023-24' किसने पेश किया?
e: Bihar ka aarthik sarvekshan vitta mantri vidhan sabha mein prastut karte hain, isliye pehla vikalp sahi hai. Yah riwayat isliye chali aayi ki pehle aise aankdon ki jankari janta tak pahunchti nahi thi; isliye budget se ek din pehle yah sarvekshan aane se rajya ki aay, kharch tatha rozgar ki asli tasveer saamne aati hai, tatha usi ke aadhar par niti tatha budget banaye jaate hain. Mukhya mantri, koi nahi tatha rajjyapal is kaam ke sahi naam nahi hain, isliye wo teeno theek nahi hain. Exam point: bihar ka aarthik sarvekshan vitta mantri prastut karte hain - yahi budget se pehle rajya ki aarthik tasveer deta hai.

qe: What is 'Fiscal Neutrality'?
qh: 'राजकोषीय तटस्थता' (Fiscal Neutrality) क्या है?
o: A budget with no net effect on aggregate demand
e: RajkoshIya tatasthta ka matlab hai aisa budget jiska kul maang par koi asar na padta ho, isliye teesra vikalp sahi hai. Iska istemal us samay hota hai jab karobar apne aap tez chal raha ho tatha sarkar ushe aur nahi badhana chahti; isliye sarkar apne kharch tatha aay ko aise tay karti hai ki bazaar ki kul maang na badhe na ghate, jisse mehngai ki lau na bhadke. Bina kar, koi nahi tatha RBI ka control - in teeno ka is dhaarna se door ka naata nahi. Exam point: fiscal neutrality mein budget ka kul maang par asar zero rehta hai - isliye karobar apne raste chalta hai.

qe: Which article deals with the 'Consolidated Fund of India'?
qh: संविधान का कौन सा अनुच्छेद 'भारत की संचित निधि' से संबंधित है?
e: Article 266 bharat ki sanchit nidhi (Consolidated Fund) se juda hai, isliye teesra vikalp sahi hai. Yah anuchhed isliye mahatvapurn hai ki sarkar ki saari aay pehle isi nidhi mein jaati hai tatha bina sansad ki manzuri wahan se ek paisa bhi kharch nahi ho sakta; isliye yahi nidhi sarkar ki thaali maani jaati hai jisse karyapalika bhi apni marji se paisa nahi nikal sakti. Article 267 aapda nidhi (Contingency Fund) ka hai, Article 110 dhan vidhayak ke baare mein hai tatha Article 280 vitt aayog ka hai, isliye wo teeno theek nahi hain. Exam point: Article 266 sanchit nidhi se juda hai - saari sarkari aay isi nidhi se chalti hai.

qe: In the Bihar Budget, what is 'Revenue Receipts' primarily composed of?
qh: बिहार बजट में 'राजस्व प्राप्तियां' मुख्य रूप से किससे बनी होती हैं?
o: State's own tax + Share in Central Taxes
e: Bihar ke budget mein rajasy praptiyan mukhya roop se rajya ke apne kar tatha kendriya kar mein hisse se banti hain, isliye chauthe vikalp mein di gayi vyakhya sahi baithti hai. Yah jaanna isliye zaroori hai ki rajya ki aay ka badha hissa isi share par nirbhar hai; isliye jab kendriya kar badhta hai to bihar ke hisse ki rakam bhi badhti hai, tatha rajya ke apne kar jaise pathkar, stamp tatha registri se bhi aay aati hai. Sampatti bikri, koi nahi tatha SBI se karz - in teeno ka yahan koi sambandh nahi. Exam point: rajasy praptiyan rajya ke apne kar tatha kendriya kar ke hisse se banti hain - ismein karz joda nahi jaata.

qe: What is the 'Fiscal Year' period in India?
qh: भारत में 'वित्तीय वर्ष' की अवधि क्या है?
e: Bharat mein vittiya varsh ek April se ekatti March tak chalta hai, isliye pehla vikalp sahi hai. Yah avadhi isliye chuni gayi ki pehle sarkar apne kharch tatha aay ka hisaab isi tarah se karti thi tatha Britani mausam ka prabhav raha; isliye aaj bhi saara budget, kar tatha khate ki jaanch isi avadhi ke hisaab se hoti hai, tatha ek July se chhah June wali soch videshi bankon ki hai. Koi nahi, ek July se chhah June tatha ek January se ikatrish December wale vikalp Sahi nahi hain, isliye wo teeno galat hain. Exam point: vittiya varsh ek April se ekatti March tak hota hai - isi avadhi ka hisaab budget mein aata hai.

qe: Which sector in Bihar contributes the most to its 'Gross State Domestic Product' (GSDP)?
qh: बिहार के GSDP में सबसे अधिक योगदान किस क्षेत्र का है?
e: Bihar ke GSDP mein sabse bada hissa teesri shreni yani sevaon ka hai, isliye doosra vikalp sahi hai. Yah badlav isliye hua ki rajya mein bank, vaaniya, vyapar, hotel tatha doosri sevaon ka failav tez hua; isliye aaj kharch tatha kamai ka bada hissa isi shreni se aata hai, jabki khane-peene wali aay mein hi aabadi ka bada hissa laga hua hai. Keval kheti, factory tatha khanan wale vikalp is vargikaran ke sahi aakde nahi hain, isliye wo teeno theek nahi hain. Exam point: bihar ke GSDP mein sevaon ka hissa sabse bada hai - isliye vikas ki raah sewaon tatha udyog mein hi hai.

qe: Under which article does the Governor of a state present the 'State Budget'?
qh: किस अनुच्छेद के तहत राज्य का राज्यपाल 'राज्य का बजट' पेश करवाता है?
e: Article 202 ke tahat rajya ka rajjyapal rajya ka budget vidhan sabha ke saamne rakhta hai, isliye chauthe vikalp ki vyakhya sahi hai. Yah rasta isliye tay kiya gaya hai ki paisa janta ke pratinidhiyon ki manzuri ke bina kharch na ho; isliye vitta mantri budget taiyar karke rajjyapal se prastut karate hain tatha manzuri ke baad hi kharch shuru hota hai. Article 360 vittiya aapda, Article 280 vitt aayog tatha Article 112 kendriya budget ke hain, isliye wo teeno vikalp galat hain. Exam point: Article 202 rajya ke budget se juda hai - isi ke tahat rajjyapal vidhan sabha mein budget rakhta hai.

qe: Which state has the 'Lowest' Per Capita Income in India?
qh: भारत में किस राज्य की 'प्रति व्यक्ति आय' सबसे कम है?
e: Bharat mein prati vyakti aay bihar ki sabse kam hai, isliye doosra vikalp sahi hai. Yah sthiti isliye bani ki yahan aabadi bahut zyada hai tatha bade udyog tatha nivesh kam hain; isliye aay ke rup mein badh firm hone par bhi prachina sankhya par bantwara hone se prati vyakti hissa desh mein sabse kam rehta hai, isi karan bihar ki baat khas taur par hoti hai. Uttar Pradesh, Odisha tatha Jharkhand bhi pichhde rajya hain par prati vyakti aay mein bihar sabse neeche hai, isliye wo teeno tek nahi hain. Exam point: prati vyakti aay bihar ki sabse kam hai - isliye baat aabadi tatha nivesh par hoti hai.

qe: Who is the current 'Finance Minister' of Bihar (as of April 2026)?
qh: बिहार के वर्तमान 'वित्त मंत्री' कौन हैं (अप्रैल 2026 के अनुसार)?
e: Bihar ke vitta mantri Samrat Choudhary hain, isliye pehla vikalp sahi hai. Yah pad isliye ahem hai ki bihar jaise rajya mein budget ka bada hissa samajik kshetra tatha adhaar-bhoomi par lagta hai; isliye rajya ka vitta mantri hi kar ke aakde, kendra se milne wala hissa tatha karz ke faasle ke hisaab se budget banate hain tatha vidhan sabha mein prastut karte hain. Nitish Kumar mukhya mantri ki bhumika mein bade niti nirdesh dete hain, Vijay Kumar Chaudhary vidhan sabha ke purv adhyaksh rahe hain tatha Tejashwi Yadav mukhya pratipaksh ke neta hain, isliye wo teeno vikalp galat hain. Exam point: bihar ke vitta mantri Samrat Choudhary hain - rajya ka budget isi pad se prastut hota hai.

qe: What is 'Fiscal Policy' determined by?
qh: 'राजकोषीय नीति' किसके द्वारा निर्धारित की जाती है?
e: RajkoshIya niti vitta mantralaya tay karta hai, isliye doosra vikalp sahi hai. Yah kaam isliye vitta mantralaya ko mila ki kar ki dar, sarkar ka kharch tatha karz lene ka saara faisla budget ke zariye yahin se hota hai; isliye yah niti desh ki aay tatha kharch ke rukh ko tay karti hai, jabki mudra niti RBI ke paas hoti hai jo byaj tatha paise ki aapurti dekhti hai. RBI, SEBI tatha NITI Aayog is kaam ke sahi naam nahi hain - RBI mudra niti dekhta hai, SEBI bazaar ko tatha NITI soch tatha salah deta hai, isliye wo teeno galat hain. Exam point: rajkoshiya niti vitta mantralaya tay karta hai - yahi kar tatha sarkari kharch ka faisla karta hai.

qe: Which organization publishes the 'Economic Survey' of India?
qh: भारत का 'आर्थिक सर्वेक्षण' कौन सा संगठन प्रकाशित करता है?
o: Ministry of Finance (Dept. of Economic Affairs)
e: Bharat ka aarthik sarvekshan vitta mantralaya (aarthik kary vibhag) chhaapta hai, isliye teesra vikalp sahi hai. Yah dastavez isliye itna ahem hai ki ismein desh ki aay, mehngai, rozgar tatha vyapar ki asli tasveer tatha aane wale saal ki sambhavna hoti hai; isliye budget se ek din pehle yah aane se saansad tatha janta ko faisle samajhne mein madad milti hai. NITI Aayog, koi nahi tatha RBI ise prakaashit nahi karte, isliye wo teeno theek nahi hain. Exam point: aarthik sarvekshan vitta mantralaya chhaapta hai - yahi budget se pehle bharat ki aarthik tasveer deta hai.

qe: What is 'Minimum Support Price' (MSP) meant to protect?
qh: 'न्यूनतम समर्थन मूल्य' (MSP) किसकी रक्षा के लिए है?
e: Nyunatam samarthan mulya (MSP) kisanaon ko daam girne se bachane ke liye hai, isliye pehla vikalp sahi hai. Yah bharosa isliye dilaya jaata hai ki ek hi fasal sab jagah ek saath taiyar hone par bazaar mein daam bahut gir jaata hai; isliye sarkar pehle se tay keemat par kharidne ka vaada karti hai, jisse kisaan bila na doob jaye tatha agla beej bone ka mann kare. Niryatkaron, dukaandaaron tatha grahakon ke liye yah nahi hai - yah to kisaan ke daam ki suraksha hai, isliye wo teeno vikalp galat hain. Exam point: MSP kisanaon ko daam girne se bachata hai - yahi kheti mein sthirta laane ka upay hai.

qe: Which Constitutional Article is related to the 'Finance Commission'?
qh: कौन सा संवैधानिक अनुच्छेद 'वित्त आयोग' से संबंधित है?
e: Article 280 vitt aayog se juda hai, isliye pehla vikalp sahi hai. Yah anuchhed isliye ahem hai ki kendriya kar ki aay ka batwara kendra tatha rajyon ke beech tay karna zaroori hai; isliye har paanch saal mein ek aayog banti hai jo rajyon ke hisse ki salah deti hai, tatha uske aadhar par kendra paisa bhejta hai. Article 250, Article 112 tatha Article 300 anya vishayon ke hain, isliye wo teeno sahi nahi hain. Exam point: vitt aayog Article 280 ke tahat banti hai - yahi kendra tatha rajyon ke beech kar ki aay baantne ki salah deti hai.

qe: What is 'Deficit Financing' used for?
qh: 'घाटे की वित्त व्यवस्था' किसलिए उपयोग की जाती है?
o: Fund public expenditure during revenue shortfall
e: Ghate ki vitt vyavastha ka istemal aay ki kami ke samay sarkari kharch poora karne ke liye hota hai, isliye chauthe vikalp mein likhi baat sahi hai. Yah rasta isliye apnaya jaata hai ki kheti, kaam tatha navachar mein nivesh ki zarurat hoti hai tatha wo pal bhar ruk na jaye; isliye sarkar naya karz lekar ya bachat istemal karke kharch poora karti hai, halaanki bahut zyada karz lene se byaj ka bojh aane wali peedhi par bhi padta hai. Kar badhana, koi nahi tatha vikas ghatana - in teeno ka is shabd se door ka naata nahi. Exam point: ghate ki vitt vyavastha aay ki kami mein sarkari kharch poora karne ke liye hoti hai - par iski seema zaroori hai.

qe: Who presents the 'Economic Survey' in Parliament?
qh: संसद में 'आर्थिक सर्वेक्षण' कौन पेश करता है?
e: Sansad mein aarthik sarvekshan vitta mantri prastut karte hain, isliye chauthe vikalp ka bayaan sahi hai. Yah riwayat isliye chali ki budget ka poora aadhar isi dastavez ke aakde hote hain; isliye yah pehle aata hai tatha uske agle din budget pesh hota hai, jisse saansad tatha janta ko sarkar ki aarthik soch samajh mein aati hai. Rashtrapati, pradhan mantri tatha RBI gavarnar ise prastut nahi karte - ye teeno alag pad hain. Exam point: aarthik sarvekshan sansad mein vitta mantri prastut karte hain - yah budget se ek din pehle aata hai.

qe: What is 'Fiscal Deficit' primarily?
qh: 'राजकोषीय घाटा' मुख्य रूप से क्या है?
o: Total borrowing requirements of the government
e: RajkoshIya ghata mukhya roop se sarkar ki karz lene ki zarurat dikhata hai, isliye doosra vikalp sahi hai. Yah baat isliye ahem hai ki ghata jitna badta hai utna hi sarkar ko bazaar se karz lena padta hai tatha byaj dena padta hai; isliye uchh ghate ka matlab hai aane wali peedhiyon par bojh, isliye sarkar ise seemit rakhne ke liye FRBM ke tahat lakshya tay karti hai. Paisa khona, kar chori tatha koi nahi - in sab ka matlab yah nahi hai. Exam point: rajkoshiya ghata sarkar ki karz lene ki zarurat batata hai - isliye ise seemit rakhna zaroori hai.

qe: What is 'Budget Deficit'?
qh: 'बजट घाटा' क्या है?
e: Budget ghata nikalne ke liye kul vyay mein se kul praptiyan ghatayi jaati hain, isliye doosra vikalp sahi hai. Iske nikaalne se sarkar ke saare kharch tatha saari aay ka saaf chitra milta hai; isliye yah rajkoshiya ghata se alag hai, kyonki ismein karz wali praptiyan bhi jod di jaati hain, isliye budget ghata aur rajkoshiya ghata ke aakde alag aate hain. Keval karz, koi nahi tatha kar mein se subsidy ghatana - in sab ka yah matlab nahi. Exam point: budget ghata = kul vyay - kul praptiyan; yah aankda rajkoshiya ghata se bada hota hai.

qe: Which organization manages 'External Debt' of India?
qh: भारत के 'बाहरी ऋण' का प्रबंधन कौन करता है?
e: Bharat ke bahya karz ka prabandhan vitta mantralaya karta hai, isliye teesra vikalp sahi hai. Yah kaam isliye vahin hota hai ki videshi karz lene tatha chukane ka saara faisla sarkar ke aarthik hisaab ke saath juda hai; isliye vitta mantralaya Reserve Bank ke zariye karz nikaalta tatha bhandaran rakhta hai, jisse desh ka keemat tatha jokhim sahi tareeke se sambhala ja sake. World Bank, koi nahi tatha SEBI is kaam ke sahi naam nahi hain - World Bank keval karz deta hai tatha SEBI bazaar dekhta hai, isliye wo teeno galat hain. Exam point: bahya karz ka prabandhan vitta mantralaya karta hai - RBI uske sahayak ki tarah karz jari karta hai.

qe: What is 'Fiscal Year' in India?
qh: भारत में 'वित्तीय वर्ष' कब शुरू होता है?
e: Bharat mein vittiya varsh ek April se shuru hota hai, isliye doosra vikalp sahi hai. Yah tareekh isliye tay hui ki phasal ka hisaab tatha purane chalan ke hisaab se yah mahina anukool tha; isliye ek April se shuru hokar ekatti March ko khatam hone wala varsh hi saare budget tatha kar ke aakdon ka aadhar hai. Koi nahi, ek July tatha ek January wale vikalp anya deshon ke chalan hain, isliye wo teeno sahi nahi hain. Exam point: vittiya varsh ek April ko shuru hota hai - yahi budget ka pehla din mana jaata hai.

qe: Which article is for 'Finance Commission'?
qh: 'वित्त आयोग' के लिए कौन सा अनुच्छेद है?
e: Vitt aayog ke liye samvidhan ka Article 280 hai, isliye doosra vikalp sahi hai. Yah anuchhed isliye itna mahatvapurn hai ki bina iske kendra aur rajyon ke beech kar ki kamai baantne ka rasta nahi khulta; isliye har paanch saal mein ek aayog banakar uske adhyaksh tatha sadasyon ki niyukti ki jaati hai, tatha usi ki salaah par kendra rajyon ko paisa bhejta hai. Article 360, Article 112 tatha koi nahi wale vikalp anya vishayon ke hain, isliye wo teeno galat hain. Exam point: vitt aayog ke liye Article 280 hai - yahi kendra-rajya ke kar batware ka aadhar hai.

qe: Which article is related to the 'Union Budget'?
qh: 'केंद्रीय बजट' से संबंधित कौन सा अनुच्छेद है?
e: Kendriya budget ka sambandh samvidhan ke Article 112 se hai, isliye pehla vikalp sahi hai. Is anuchhed ke tahat rashtrapati ke kehne par vitta mantri sansad ke saamne desh ka saalana aay-kharch ka lekhajokha rakhte hain, jisse bina manzuri sarkar ek paisa bhi kharch nahi kar sakti. Article 110 dhan vidhayak se juda hai jo keval kar tatha karz ke prastavon ko tay karta hai, Article 280 vitt aayog banane ka rasta batata hai tatha Article 360 vittiya aapda ke liye hai, isliye wo teeno yahan ghise nahi utarte. Exam point: kendriya budget Article 112 ke tahat aata hai tatha ise varshik vittiya vivran kaha jaata hai.

qe: Which state has 'Lowest' PCI?
qh: किस राज्य की 'प्रति व्यक्ति आय' सबसे कम है?
e: Prati vyakti aay ke mamle mein bihar ka ankhada desh mein sabse neecha hai, isliye chauthe vikalp mein diya gaya naam sahi hai. Yahan aabadi ka bojh bahut bada hai tatha bade karkhane aur nivesh ki kami hai; isliye kheti ki kamai bahut logon mein bant jaati hai tatha hisse mein bahut kam bachti hai. Koi nahi, Odisha tatha UP bhi pichhde rajya hain par sabse kam prati vyakti aay bihar ki hai, isliye inmein se koi is prashn ka sahi jawab nahi hai. Exam point: sabse kam prati vyakti aay wala rajya bihar hai - iski badi wajah aabadi ka bojh tatha nivesh ki kami hai.

qe: Which article is for 'State Budget'?
qh: 'राज्य बजट' का अनुच्छेद कौन सा है?
e: Rajya ke budget ke liye samvidhan ka Article 202 tay kiya gaya hai, isliye doosra vikalp sahi hai. Is anuchhed ke tahat rajya ka rajjyapal vidhan sabha ke saamne rajya ka saalana lekhajokha rakhwata hai, jisse vidhayak kharch par bahes tatha manzuri de sakte hain. Koi nahi, Article 112 kendra ke budget se juda hai tatha Article 280 kar batware ki aayog se, isliye ye teeno anuchhed yahan kaam ke nahi. Exam point: rajya budget Article 202 ke tahat aata hai tatha ise rajya ka varshik vittiya vivran kaha jaata hai.

qe: What is 'Deficit Financing'?
qh: 'घाटे की वित्त व्यवस्था' क्या है?
o: Borrowing or printing money to cover budget gap
e: Ghate ki vitt vyavastha ka matlab hai sarkar ka kharch aay se zyada hone par us kami ko karz lekar ya naya paisa chhaap kar bharna, isliye doosra vikalp sahi hai. Yah upay isliye kaam aata hai ki kheti tatha naye kaam par kharch turant rukna nahi chahiye; halaanki karz bahut badh jaye to byaj chukane mein paisa lag jaata hai tatha note chhapne se mehngai bhadak uthti hai. Zero budget, koi nahi tatha paisa bachana wale vikalp is shabd ke sahi khulaase nahi hain, isliye inmein se koi is shabd ka poora arth nahi batata. Exam point: ghate ki vitt vyavastha ka matlab karz ya naya paisa chhaap kar badhaya hua kharch hai - yahi dono ke jokhim ke saath aata hai.

qe: Which 'Finance Commission' is currently in effect (for 2021-2026)?
qh: वर्तमान में कौन सा 'वित्त आयोग' प्रभावी है (2021-2026 के लिए)?
e: Bharat mein 2021 se 2026 ki avadhi ke liye pandrahva vitt aayog kaam kar raha hai, isliye chauthe vikalp ka naam sahi hai. Yah aayog isliye har paanch saal mein banayi jaati hai ki kar ki kamai baantne ka rasta tay ho; isliye isne rajyon ke hisse ko 42 se ghata kar 41 pratishat kiya tatha sehat aur sadkein banane par zyada kharch ki raay di. Chaudahvin aayog ki avadhi pichhli thi, solahvin aayog ki salah aane wali avadhi ke liye hogi tatha koi nahi wala vikalp yahan galat hai, isliye wo teeno is prashn ke sahi jawab nahi. Exam point: 2021-2026 ke liye pandrahva vitt aayog lagu hai jiske adhyaksh N.K. Singh hain.

qe: What is the 'Vertical Devolution' share of states recommended by the 15th Finance Commission?
qh: 15वें वित्त आयोग द्वारा राज्यों के लिए 'ऊर्ध्वाधर हस्तांतरण' (Vertical Devolution) का हिस्सा कितना अनुशंसित है?
e: Pandrahve vitt aayog ne rajyon ke liye kar ki aay ka ulamba hastantaran yaani vertical devolution 41 pratishat rakha, isliye pehla vikalp sahi hai. Yah hissa isliye thoda ghata ki Jammu-Kashmir tatha Ladakh ko naya kendra shasit pradesh banaya gaya, jisse unki zaruraton ke liye paisa alag se rakhna pada; isliye pehle ka 42 pratishat hissa ab 41 pratishat rah gaya tatha bihar jaise rajya ko hisse ke hisaab se paisa milta hai. Battis pratishat, bayalis pratishat tatha pachaas pratishat wale ankhade is raay se mel nahi khaate, isliye inmein se koi soochi mein nahi aata. Exam point: pandrahve vitt aayog mein rajyon ka ulamba hastantaran 41 pratishat hai tatha yahi kar ki aay ka bada hissa hai.

qe: What is 'Public Debt' in the context of India?
qh: भारत के संदर्भ में 'सार्वजनिक ऋण' (Public Debt) क्या है?
o: Total liabilities of the Union Govt
e: Sarkar ke sandarbh mein public debt ka matlab kendra sarkar ki kul dayitvai hoti hai, isliye chauthe vikalp mein jo likha hai wahi sahi hai. Yah isliye ahem hai ki ismein ek taraf desh ke andar se liya gaya karz (market loan tatha treasury bill) aata hai tatha doosri taraf videshi karz aata hai; isliye sarkar ko har saal byaj chukane ke saath asli rakam bhi lautani padti hai, isliye yah aankda rajkoshiya ghate ke saath dekhkar hi sarkar ki asli sthiti samajh mein aati hai. Koi nahi, janta dwara diya karz tatha bankon ka paisa is poore dayitv ka sahi khulaasa nahi hain, isliye inmein se koi bhi is jagah nahi baithta. Exam point: public debt sarkar ke kul dayitvon ko kaha jaata hai jismein andaruni tatha bahya karz dono jude hote hain.

qe: Which body is responsible for 'Auditing' the accounts of the Union and State governments?
qh: केंद्र और राज्य सरकारों के खातों की 'ऑडिटिंग' के लिए कौन सा निकाय जिम्मेदार है?
e: Kendra tatha rajyon ke khaaton ki janch ka kaam bharat ke niyantrak tatha mahalekhaparikshak karte hain, isliye pehla vikalp sahi hai. Yah pad isliye samvidhan ke Article 148 ke tahat banaya gaya ki sarkar jis paise ka kharch kare uska swatantra hisaab bhi ho; isliye CAG ki riport sansad tatha vidhan sabha mein rakhi jaati hai, tatha usi ke aadhar par kharch ki safai tay hoti hai. NITI Aayog, vitt aayog tatha RBI is kaam ke sahi naam nahi hain - NITI salah deta hai, vitt aayog kar ke batware par sochti hai tatha RBI mudra dekhta hai, isliye inmein se koi is zimmedari ke laayak nahi. Exam point: khaaton ki janch CAG karta hai tatha yah samvidhan ke Article 148 ke tahat ek swatantra pad hai.

qe: What is 'Crowding Out' effect?
qh: 'क्राउडिंग आउट' (Crowding Out) प्रभाव क्या है?
o: Govt borrowing leading to less credit for private sector
e: Crowding out ka matlab hai sarkar ka zyada karz lena jisse niji kshetra ko kam karz milta hai, isliye teesra vikalp sahi hai. Yah asar isliye padta hai ki sarkar bazaar se bahut paisa maangti hai to paise ki keemat yaani byaj dar chadhi jaati hai; isliye factory tatha dukaandar mahange byaj par karz lene se katrate hain, jisse nivesh tatha rozgar ghat jaate hain, bhale hi sarkar ka kharch bada dikhe. Koi nahi, logon ka bazaar chhodna tatha tez mehngai is shabd ke sahi matlab nahi hain, isliye inmein se koi ise theek nahi samjhata. Exam point: crowding out mein sarkari karz niji nivesh ko peeche dhakel deta hai - isliye ghata seemit rakhna zaroori hai.

qe: What is 'Plan Expenditure' (until 2017)?
qh: 'योजनागत व्यय' क्या था (2017 तक)?
o: Spending on Five Year Plan projects
e: Iske pehle 2017 tak sarkar ke kharch ko yojana tatha gair-yojana ke do hisson mein baanta jaata tha, isliye chauthe vikalp wala arth sahi hai. Yojnagat kharch isliye kaha jaata tha ki wo paanch saal ki yojna ke tay kaam tatha naye projekton par lagta hai; isliye yahi kharch vikas banane wala mana jaata tha, jabki gair-yojana kharch vetan tatha byaj jaise roz ke kharch ke liye tha. Koi nahi, vetan par kharch tatha byaj ka bhugtan gair-yojana kharch mein aata tha, isliye ye teeno is tay kram ke nahi hain. Exam point: yojnagat kharch paanch saal ki yojna ke kaam par lagta tha tatha 2017 se yah baantna band kar diya gaya.

qe: What is 'Balanced Budget'?
qh: 'संतुलित बजट' (Balanced Budget) क्या है?
e: Santulit budget (Balanced Budget) tab mana jaata hai jab sarkar ki anumaanit kul praptiyan tatha kul vyay barabar ho, isliye doosra vikalp theek baithta hai. Iska mahatva isliye hai ki ismein karz nahi lena padta tatha byaj ka bojh aane wali peedhiyon par nahi jaata; halaanki kheti tatha naye kaam mein nivesh ki zyada zarurat ke samay yah kaam nahi aata, isliye zyadatar sarkarein kami tatha ghate ke bina kaam nahi chalti. Bina kar, koi nahi tatha praptiyan kharch se zyada wale vikalp is shabd ke sahi khaas matlab nahi hain, isliye inmein se koi aisa hisaab nahi darshata. Exam point: santulit budget mein kul praptiyan tatha kul vyay barabar rehte hain tatha karz lene ki zarurat nahi padti.

qe: Who is 'Chairman' of Finance Commission?
qh: 15वें वित्त आयोग के 'अध्यक्ष' कौन हैं?
e: Pandrahve vitt aayog ke adhyaksh N.K. Singh the, isliye chauthe vikalp wali soch sahi hai. Yah aayog isliye 2021 se 2026 tak ke liye kaam kar rahi hai ki kar ki aay ka batwara tatha rajyon ki zaruraton ka ankhada samay samay par badalta rehta hai; isliye isne rajyon ka hissa 41 pratishat tatha nakadi suvidhaon par kharch badhane ki salah di, jisse bihar tatha doosre pichhde rajya ko zyada paisa mila. Vijay Kelkar tatha Y.V. Reddy pehle ke aayogon se jude naam hain tatha koi nahi wala vikalp yahan galat hai, isliye ye teeno naam yahan sateek nahi hain. Exam point: pandrahve vitt aayog ke adhyaksh N.K. Singh hain tatha unki salah 2021-2026 ke liye lagu hai.

qe: Which article is for 'Union Budget'?
qh: 'केंद्रीय बजट' का अनुच्छेद:
e: Kendra ke budget ka samvidhanik aadhar Article 112 hai - yahi pehla vikalp hai. Is anuchhed ko yaad rakhna zaroori hai kyonki ise varshik vittiya vivran kaha jaata hai tatha rashtrapati ke aadesh par vitta mantri ise sansad ke saamne rakhte hain; isliye iske bina sarkar ka ek bhi kharch tay nahi ho sakta. Article 110, koi nahi tatha Article 360 anya vishyon ke anuchhed hain - Article 110 dhan vidhayak tatha Article 360 vittiya aapda ka hai, isliye ye teeno yahan sahi nahi chunte. Exam point: kendriya budget Article 112 se juda hai tatha isi ke tahat sansad mein prastut hota hai.

qe: Which state in India was the 'First' to present a paperless budget?
qh: पेपरलेस बजट पेश करने वाला भारत का 'पहला' राज्य कौन सा था?
e: Paperless budget pesh karne wala bharat ka pehla rajya Uttar Pradesh tha, isliye pehla vikalp sahi hai. Yah badlav isliye hua ki sabhi dastavez, aakde tatha vetan ka bhugtan online hone shuru hue; isliye 2021 mein UP ne pehli baar tablet par hi poora budget vidhan sabha ke saamne rakha, jisse kaagaz tatha chhapai ka kharch bachta hai tatha aay-kharch ka hisaab tez banta hai. Gujarat, bihar tatha Kerala bhi kai digital kadam utha chuke hain par pehla paperless budget UP ka tha, isliye ye teeno yahan sahi nahi hain. Exam point: pehla paperless budget Uttar Pradesh ne 2021 mein pesh kiya - yahi digital saasan ki taraf bada kadam tha.

qe: What is 'Fiscal Year' period in India?
qh: भारत में 'वित्तीय वर्ष' की अवधि:
e: Bharat ka vittiya varsh April mahine ki pehli tareekh se shuru hokar March ki ekatti tareekh ko samaapt hota hai, isliye teesra vikalp sahi hai. Yah chunav purane chalan se juda hai; isliye sarkar apni aay, kharch tatha karz ka poora lekhajokha inhi baarah mahinon mein band karti hai tatha agle saal ka budget isi hisaab par banta hai. January se December tatha July se June ke tareeke videshi deshon ke hain tatha koi nahi wala vikalp galat hai, isliye ye teeno yahan nahi chunte. Exam point: kendra tatha rajya dono ka lekhajokha April se March ke baarah mahine ka hota hai - isi liye budget ka saal isi avadhi par chalta hai.

qe: Who is 'Chairman' of Finance Commission (15th)?
qh: 15वें वित्त आयोग के अध्यक्ष:
e: Pandrahve vitt aayog ki kamaa par adhyaksh ke roop mein N.K. Singh the, isliye pehla vikalp sahi hai. Unka naam isliye yaad rakhna chahiye ki 2021 se 2026 tak ki avadhi, 41 pratishat wala hissa tatha nakadi suvidhaon ki raashi - sab isi aayog ki riport se jude hain. Manmohan Singh desh ke purv pradhan mantri rahe hain tatha Urjit Patel RBI ke gavarnar, jabki koi nahi wala vikalp yahan galat hai, isliye ye teeno soochi se bahar hain. Exam point: N.K. Singh hain pandrahve vitt aayog ke adhyaksh - unki riport 2021-26 ki avadhi par lagu hai.

qe: What is 'Bihar Industrial Investment Promotion Policy' mainly focused on?
qh: 'बिहार औद्योगिक निवेश प्रोत्साहन नीति' मुख्य रूप से किस पर केंद्रित है?
e: Bihar audyogik nivesh protsahan niti ka jor ethanol tatha khane-peene ki cheezon ki processing par hai, isliye teesra vikalp sahi hai. Yah chunav isliye hua ki rajya mein anaj, ganna tatha doodh badi matra mein paida hota hai par unhe sambhalne tatha bechne ke udyog kam the; isliye ethanol tatha khane ki cheezon ke karkhane lagane se kisaan ko sahi daam tatha kaam dhoondhne wale logon ko rozgar milta hai. Bhari machine, keval khanan tatha koi nahi wale vikalp is niti ke sahi maksad nahi hain, isliye ye teeno is niti ke daayre se bahar hain. Exam point: bihar ki udyog niti ka kendra ethanol tatha khane-peene ki cheezon ki processing hai - yahi kheti tatha udyog ko jodti hai.

qe: What is 'Special Category Status' (SCS) often demanded by Bihar?
qh: बिहार द्वारा अक्सर मांगी जाने वाली 'विशेष श्रेणी का दर्जा' (SCS) क्या है?
o: Increased central funding and tax breaks
e: Vishesh shreni ka darja (SCS) milne par rajya ko kendra ki yojnaon mein badi raashi anudaan ke roop mein tatha kar mein chhoot milti hai, isliye teesra vikalp sahi hai. Vishisht shreni ki rajyaon ko kendra ki yojnaon ka 90 pratishat hissa bina lautaye paisa (grant) ke roop mein milta hai; isliye bihar bar-bar yah darja maangta hai ki uski aay kam hone ke kaaran bhaari kharch tatha udyog lene ka bojh kendra sambhale. Keval extra police tatha extra zameen wale vikalp is darje ka matlab nahi batate, koi nahi bhi galat hai; isliye inmein se koi is darje ke gun nahi rakhta. Exam point: SCS mein kendra ki yojnaon mein 90 pratishat paisa anudaan mein milta hai - isliye pichhde rajya ise maangte hain.

qe: Which district of Bihar is known for having the highest GSDP contribution?
qh: बिहार के किस जिले का GSDP में सबसे अधिक योगदान है?
e: Bihar ke jilon mein GSDP mein sabse bada hissa Patna ka hai, isliye doosra vikalp sahi hai. Rajdhani hone ke kaaran yahan daftar, bank, vaaniya tatha sevaon ke kaam ek jagah jama hain; isliye tez khapat tatha nivesh bhi yahin hota hai, jabki Muzaffarpur tatha Bhagalpur jaise jile khane-peene tatha bhandar ke kaam mein aage hain par aakde mein Patna se peeche hain. Muzaffarpur, Bhagalpur tatha Gaya bade jile zaroor hain par GSDP ke hisse mein Patna sabse aage hai, isliye inmein se koi soochi mein sabse aage nahi hai. Exam point: GSDP mein Patna jile ka hissa sabse zyada hai - yah rajya ka aarthik kendra hai.

qe: What is the main focus of 'Bihar Budget 2024-25'?
qh: 'बिहार बजट 2024-25' का मुख्य फोकस क्या है?
e: Bihar budget 2024-25 ka mukhya jor mahila sashaktikaran, kheti tatha aadhaar-bhoomi par raha, isliye chauthe vikalp ke shabd sahi hain. Yah jor isliye diya gaya ki rajya ki aabadi mein aadhi mahilayen hain tatha zyadatar log kheti par nirbhar hain; isliye mahilaon ki padhai, sehat tatha unke samoohon ko karz dene par khaas dhyan diya gaya, saath hi sadak, bijli tatha sinchai par kharch bade. Keval udyog, keval IT tatha koi nahi wale vikalp is budget ke asli kharch ke hisaab se sahi nahi hain, isliye ye teeno asli kharch ke hisaab se galat hain. Exam point: is budget ka mukhya jor mahila sashaktikaran, kheti tatha aadhaar-bhoomi hai.

qe: In Bihar Budget 2024-25, which scheme received significant allocation for 'Girls' Education'?
qh: बिहार बजट 2024-25 में, 'बालिका शिक्षा' के लिए किस योजना को महत्वपूर्ण आवंटन मिला?
e: Balika shiksha ke liye bihar budget 2024-25 mein mukhyamantri balika cycle yojana ko badi raashi mili, isliye teesra vikalp sahi hai. Is yojana ka maksad gaon ki ladkiyon ka school jaana aasan karna tha, kyonki school dur hone par aane-jaane mein dikkat hoti thi tatha padhai adhoori chhoot jaati thi; isliye cycle milne se ladkiyon ka daakhla tatha padhne ka samay badha, tatha yahi yojana aaj bhi balika shiksha ka bada sahara hai. Digital Bihar, Skill India tatha koi nahi wale vikalp anya yojnaon ke naam hain, isliye ye teeno yahan ginte nahi. Exam point: mukhyamantri balika cycle yojana balika shiksha ko badhane wali yojana hai - isse ladkiyon ka aana-jaana aasan hua.

qe: In the Bihar Budget 2024-25, how much is the 'Total Estimated Expenditure'?
qh: बिहार बजट 2024-25 में 'कुल अनुमानित व्यय' कितना है?
e: Bihar budget 2024-25 ka kul anumaanit vyay karib 2.78 lakh crore rupaye tha, isliye doosra vikalp sahi hai. Yah ankhada isliye ahem hai ki isse samajh mein aata hai ki rajya apni aay se kitna zyada kharch kar raha hai; isliye kendra ke hisse tatha karz par nirbharta ka bhi pata chalta hai. Paanch lakh crore, das lakh crore tatha dedh lakh crore wale aakde bihar ke is budget se mel nahi khaate, isliye ye teeno yahan sahi nahi hain. Exam point: bihar budget 2024-25 ka kul vyay karib 2.78 lakh crore rupaye tha - isi hisaab se kharch tay hua.

qe: What is the 'Fiscal Deficit' target for Bihar in the 2024-25 budget?
qh: 2024-25 के बजट में बिहार के लिए 'राजकोषीय घाटा' (Fiscal Deficit) का लक्ष्य क्या है?
e: Bihar ne apne budget mein GSDP ke hisaab se rajkoshiya ghata (Fiscal Deficit) 2.98 pratishat rakha tha, isliye chauthe vikalp ke ankhade sahi hain. Yah seema isliye tay ki gayi ki FRBM ke niyam ke tahat rajya ka ghata GSDP ke teen pratishat se zyada nahi hona chahiye; isliye ise teen se neeche rakhkar sarkar ne karz lene ki raah par lagam rakhi, jisse aane wale saal byaj ka bojh na badhe. Das pratishat, paanch pratishat tatha shunya wale aakde is seema ke sahi nahi hain, isliye inmein se koi yahan chun nahi sakta. Exam point: bihar ka rajkoshiya ghata GSDP ka 2.98 pratishat tay hua tha - yahi teen pratishat wali seema ke andar hai.

qe: Which district of Bihar has the 'Highest' Per Capita Income?
qh: बिहार के किस जिले की 'प्रति व्यक्ति आय' सबसे अधिक है?
e: Bihar ke jilon mein prati vyakti aay Patna ki sabse zyada hai, isliye pehla vikalp sahi hai. Rajdhani hone ke naate yahan bade daftar, bank tatha padhai ki sansthaen hain; isliye uchh vetan wale kaam zyada hain tatha aabadi ke muqable aay ka batwara behtar hota hai, isliye Patna ka ankhada saare jilon se aage nikalta hai. Gaya, Munger tatha Begusarai ke aakde Patna se kam hain, isliye inmein se koi soochi mein Patna se aage nahi. Exam point: prati vyakti aay mein Patna jila sabse aage hai - yahi rajya ka sabse ameer jila mana jaata hai.

qe: Which district of Bihar has the 'Lowest' Per Capita Income?
qh: बिहार के किस जिले की 'प्रति व्यक्ति आय' सबसे कम है?
e: Sheohar jile ki prati vyakti aay bihar mein sabse kam hai, isliye pehla vikalp sahi hai. Yah jila isliye peeche rah gaya ki yahan udyog tatha tej aay ke kaam na hone ke kaaran logon ko bahar jaakar mazdoori karni padti hai; isliye aabadi ke hisaab se kamai bahut kam bachti hai, jisse Sheohar ka ankhada saare jilon mein sabse neeche rehta hai. Purnia, Sitamarhi tatha Araria bhi pichhde jile hain par Sheohar se aage hain, isliye ye teeno yahan sahi nahi hain. Exam point: prati vyakti aay mein Sheohar sabse neeche hai - isse pata chalta hai ki pichhda-pan kuch jilon mein zyada hai.

qe: Who presents the 'Economic Survey' of Bihar in the state assembly?
qh: राज्य विधानसभा में बिहार का 'आर्थिक सर्वेक्षण' कौन पेश करता है?
e: Rajya ke aarthik sarvekshan ko vidhan sabha ke saamne rakhne ka kaam rajya ke vitta mantri ka hai, isliye teesra naam sahi hai. Yah dastavez budget se pehle isliye aata hai ki rajya ki aay, kharch, rozgar tatha kheti ki asli sthiti pahle saamne aa jaye; isliye vidhayak usi ke aakdon par budget par bahes tatha manzuri karte hain. Rajjyapal, mukhya mantri tatha koi nahi is kaam ke sahi naam nahi hain - rajjyapal budget vidhan sabha mein rakhwate hain par sarvekshan nahi, isliye ye teeno theek nahi. Exam point: vidhan sabha mein aarthik sarvekshan rakhne wale rajya ke vitta mantri hote hain - yahi budget banne se pehle ka bada kadam hai.

qe: Which sector in Bihar has shown the highest growth rate recently?
qh: बिहार के किस क्षेत्र ने हाल ही में उच्चतम विकास दर दिखाई है?
e: Bihar mein sabse tez vikas sevaon wale teesre kshetra ka raha hai, isliye doosra vikalp sahi hai. Bank, vaaniya, transport tatha sanchaar jaise kaam isliye tez bade ki sadkein tatha mobile saans bharose pahunche; isliye naye daftar tatha dukaane khule, jabki kheti tatha factory wala kshetra inkee tulna mein dheere badha. Kheti wala pehla kshetra tatha factory wala doosra kshetra iske peeche hain tatha koi nahi wala vikalp yahan galat hai, isliye ye teeno isi wajah se hata diye jaate hain. Exam point: vikas ki raftaar sevaon wale teesre kshetra mein sabse zyada rahi - isliye aay bhi wahin se badhi.

qe: What is 'Internal Debt' of the government?
qh: सरकार का 'आंतरिक ऋण' (Internal Debt) क्या है?
o: Loan raised within the country from citizens and banks
e: Desh ke andar hi janta, bankon tatha sansthaon se liya gaya karz antarik karz (Internal Debt) kehlata hai, isliye teesra vikalp sahi hai. Ismein market loan tatha treasury bill tatha chhote samay ke kagaz jude hote hain; isliye ise desh ki apni mudra mein chukaya jaata hai, isliye ispar videshi mudra ke badalne ka khatra nahi hota tatha byaj bhi kam hota hai. World Bank tatha IMF se liya gaya karz bahya karz kehlata hai tatha koi nahi wala vikalp galat hai, isliye ye teeno sahi jawab nahi hain. Exam point: antarik karz desh ke andar se liya gaya karz hai - yahi market loan tatha treasury bill se banta hai.

qe: What is the main objective of the 'FRBM Act' (2003)?
qh: 'FRBM अधिनियम' (2003) का मुख्य उद्देश्य क्या है?
e: FRBM adhiniyam 2003 ka mukhya maksad rajkoshiya anushasan tatha ghate ko ghatana hai, isliye doosra vikalp sahi hai. Yah kanoon isliye laaya gaya ki sarkar har saal aay se zyada kharch karke karz ka bojh na badhaye; isliye ismein ghata tatha karz ke lakshya tay kiye gaye tatha sansad ke saamne unki riport dena zaroori kiya gaya. Koi nahi, aayat badhana tatha kar badhana wale vikalp is kanoon ke maksad nahi hain, isliye ye teeno yahan sahi nahi hain. Exam point: FRBM adhiniyam 2003 rajkoshiya anushasan ka kanoon hai - yahi ghate tatha karz par lagam rakhta hai.

qe: In Bihar, where is the 'Leather Cluster' primarily being developed?
qh: बिहार में 'लेदर क्लस्टर' मुख्य रूप से कहाँ विकसित किया जा रहा है?
e: Bihar ka leather cluster Muzaffarpur ke Bela kshetra mein vikasit kiya ja raha hai, isliye chauthe vikalp ke sthan sahi hain. Yah cluster isliye banaya ja raha hai ki yahan chamde tatha jooton ka kaam pehle se hota aaya hai par sab kuch chhote star par; isliye ek jagah par training, machine tatha bazaar ki suvidha milne se hazaron logon ko rozgar tatha niryat ka naya rasta mil raha hai. Patna, Gaya tatha Bhagalpur mein anya udyog hain par leather cluster Muzaffarpur mein hai, isliye ye teeno sthan yahan khaali jaate hain. Exam point: leather cluster Muzaffarpur ke Bela kshetra mein banta hai - yahi bihar ke chamde ke udyog ka bada kendra hai.

qe: Which organization in India calculates the 'Fiscal Deficit'?
qh: भारत में 'राजकोषीय घाटा' की गणना कौन करता है?
e: The Budget division under the Department of Economic Affairs (Ministry of Finance) estimates and tracks the deficit. / वित्त मंत्रालय का बजट विभाग यह तय करता है कि सरकार को कितना घाटा हुआ है।

qe: Which district of Bihar is famous for 'Silk' production (Silk Cluster)?
qh: बिहार का कौन सा जिला 'रेशम' उत्पादन (सिल्क क्लस्टर) के लिए प्रसिद्ध है?
e: Bhagalpur is known as the 'Silk City' of Bihar and is a major cluster for Tussar silk. / भागलपुर को 'सिल्क सिटी' कहा जाता है क्योंकि यहाँ रेशमी कपड़ों का बड़ा कारोबार है।

qe: What is 'Capital Expenditure' (Capex)?
qh: 'पूंजीगत व्यय' (Capex) क्या है?
o: Spending on creation of assets like roads and bridges
e: Capex leads to the creation of productive assets that help in long-term economic growth. / ऐसा खर्च जिससे देश में नई संपत्तियां बनती हैं और भविष्य में कमाई होती है।

qe: What is 'Revenue Expenditure'?
qh: 'राजस्व व्यय' क्या है?
e: It is spending that does not result in the creation of assets or reduction of liabilities. / यह वह पैसा है जो सरकार को सिस्टम चलाने (तनख्वाह, पेंशन) के लिए खर्च करना पड़ता है।

qe: Where is the 'Pharma Cluster' being developed in Bihar?
qh: बिहार में 'फार्मा क्लस्टर' कहाँ विकसित किया जा रहा है?
e: Hajipur is being developed as a hub for pharmaceutical industries and food processing in Bihar. / हाजीपुर में दवाओं की फैक्ट्रियों के लिए विशेष औद्योगिक क्षेत्र विकसित किया जा रहा है।

qe: What is 'Crowding Out' effect related to?
qh: 'क्राउडिंग आउट' प्रभाव किससे संबंधित है?
o: High government borrowing reducing private investment
e: When the government borrows too much, interest rates rise, leaving less capital for private businesses to borrow. / जब सरकार सारा पैसा उधार ले लेती है, तो प्राइवेट कंपनियों के लिए पैसा कम और महंगा हो जाता है।

qe: What is 'Zero-Based Budgeting' (ZBB)?
qh: 'शून्य आधारित बजट' (ZBB) क्या है?
o: Preparing budget from scratch without considering previous year
e: Every expense must be justified for each new period, starting from a 'zero base'. / इसमें हर खर्च को नए सिरे से सही साबित करना होता है, पुरानी लकीर नहीं पीटी जाती।

qe: Which article of Indian Constitution gives power to the President to constitute a 'Finance Commission'?
qh: संविधान का कौन सा अनुच्छेद राष्ट्रपति को 'वित्त आयोग' गठन की शक्ति देता है?
e: The Finance Commission is constituted every five years to recommend tax distribution. / अनुच्छेद 280 के तहत हर 5 साल में टैक्स के बंटवारे के लिए यह आयोग बनता है।

qe: Who presents the 'Union Budget' in India?
qh: भारत में 'केंद्रीय बजट' कौन पेश करता है?
e: The Union Finance Minister presents the budget in the Lok Sabha on 1st February. / भारत के वित्त मंत्री संसद में बजट भाषण देते हैं और बजट पेश करते हैं।

qe: What is the 'Full Form' of FRBM Act?
qh: FRBM अधिनियम का 'पूर्ण रूप' क्या है?
e: Enacted to set targets for the government to reduce fiscal deficits and ensure financial stability. / यह सरकार को घाटा कम करने और अनुशासन में रहने के लिए कानूनन मजबूर करता है।

qe: What is 'Escapist Clause' in FRBM Act?
qh: FRBM अधिनियम में 'एस्केपिस्ट क्लॉज' क्या है?
o: Provision to exceed deficit targets during national emergencies/wars
e: Allows the government to relax fiscal deficit targets during calamities or structural reforms in the economy. / विशेष हालातों में सरकार को तय सीमा से थोड़ा ज्यादा खर्च करने की छूट देता है।

qe: What is 'Outcome Budgeting'?
qh: 'परिणामोन्मुखी बजट' (Outcome Budgeting) क्या है?
o: Tracking the actual physical progress/results of spending
e: Instead of just looking at how much money was allocated, it looks at what was actually achieved (e.g., how many km of road built). / यह सिर्फ पैसे बांटने की नहीं, बल्कि उससे क्या काम हुआ (जैसे कितने स्कूल बने), यह देखने की प्रक्रिया है।

qe: What is 'Gender Budgeting'?
qh: 'जेंडर बजटिंग' (Gender Budgeting) क्या है?
o: Budgetary process that evaluates effects on women and ensures equitable resource distribution
e: It is not a separate budget for women, but a way to ensure development reaches women effectively. / यह सुनिश्चित करना कि बजट का लाभ और नीतियां महिलाओं के विकास में सहायक हों।

qe: What is 'Monetized Deficit'?
qh: 'मुद्रीकृत घाटा' (Monetized Deficit) क्या है?
o: The part of government deficit financed by RBI through printing money
e: When the government borrows directly from RBI by issuing new currency, often leading to high inflation. / जब सरकार घाटा पूरा करने के लिए सीधे RBI से पैसे छपवाती है।

qe: What is 'Consolidated Fund of India' (Article 266)?
qh: 'भारत की संचित निधि' (अनुच्छेद 266) क्या है?
o: The main fund where all govt revenues are credited and expenses are debited
e: No money can be withdrawn from this fund without the Parliament's approval. / संसद की अनुमति के बिना इस फंड से एक रुपया भी नहीं निकाला जा सकता।

qe: What is 'Contingency Fund of India' (Article 267)?
qh: 'भारत की आकस्मिकता निधि' (अनुच्छेद 267) क्या है?
o: Fund for meeting unforeseen or urgent expenditures like disasters
e: It is placed at the disposal of the President of India to meet urgent requirements pending Parliamentary approval. / यह राष्ट्रपति के पास होता है ताकि इमरजेंसी में तुरंत पैसा निकाला जा सके।

qe: What is 'Public Account of India'?
qh: 'भारत का सार्वजनिक खाता' क्या है?
o: Fund for money where govt acts as a banker (e.g. Provident Funds, Small Savings)
e: Money in this account does not belong to the government and must be paid back to the public. Parliamentary approval is not needed for withdrawals. / यह जनता का पैसा है जो सरकार के पास जमा है, इसलिए इसे निकालने के लिए संसद की मंजूरी नहीं चाहिए।

qe: What is the 'Primary Objective' of the Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana?
qh: प्रधानमंत्री फसल बीमा योजना का 'मुख्य उद्देश्य' क्या है?
e: Provides financial support to farmers suffering from crop loss due to natural calamities. / प्राकृतिक आपदाओं के कारण फसल नुकसान होने पर किसानों को वित्तीय सहायता।

qe: Which of these is NOT a part of the 'Public Account of India'?
qh: इनमें से कौन सा 'भारत के सार्वजनिक खाते' का हिस्सा नहीं है?
e: Customs duty is a tax revenue and goes to the Consolidated Fund of India. Public Account consists of money held by the govt as a banker. / सीमा शुल्क संचित निधि (Consolidated Fund) में जाता है, जबकि सार्वजनिक खाते में जनता का जमा पैसा (जैसे PF) होता है।

qe: What is 'Primary Deficit' formula?
qh: 'प्राथमिक घाटा' का सूत्र क्या है?
e: Shows government's borrowing needs excluding the interest burden of previous years' loans. / यह बताता है कि इस साल के काम के लिए सरकार को कितनी उधारी चाहिए, पुराने कर्ज का ब्याज हटाकर।

qe: According to 'Bihar Budget 2024-25', which sector received the highest allocation?
qh: 'बिहार बजट 2024-25' के अनुसार, किस क्षेत्र को सबसे अधिक आवंटन प्राप्त हुआ?
e: Education remains a top priority for the Bihar government, receiving the largest share of the budget. / बिहार सरकार ने अपने बजट का सबसे बड़ा हिस्सा शिक्षा क्षेत्र के विकास के लिए रखा है।

qe: Which state budget presented the 'Seven Resolves' (Saat Nischay-2) for development?
qh: किस राज्य के बजट में विकास के लिए 'सात निश्चय-2' पेश किए गए?
e: Saat Nischay-2 is the blueprint for Bihar's development, focusing on youth, women, and rural infrastructure. / सात निश्चय-2 बिहार सरकार की विकास योजनाओं का मुख्य आधार है।

qe: What is 'Fiscal Capacity' of a state?
qh: किसी राज्य की 'राजकोषीय क्षमता' (Fiscal Capacity) क्या है?
o: Ability of a state govt to raise revenue from its own sources
e: It reflects the underlying economic strength of a state to fund its own services and infrastructure. / यह बताता है कि राज्य अपने दम पर कितना टैक्स और कमाई कर सकता है।

qe: In the Bihar Budget, what does 'Capital Receipts' include?
qh: बिहार बजट में 'पूंजीगत प्राप्तियां' (Capital Receipts) में क्या शामिल है?
o: Loans taken by the govt and recovery of loans
e: Capital receipts either create a liability or reduce an asset for the government. / इसमें वह पैसा आता है जो सरकार कर्ज के रूप में लेती है या पुरानी उधारी वापस पाती है।

qe: What is 'Fiscal Surplus'?
qh: 'राजकोषीय अधिशेष' (Fiscal Surplus) क्या है?
e: A situation where the government's income exceeds its spending in a fiscal year. / जब सरकार की कमाई उसके कुल खर्च से ज्यादा हो जाए, तो उसे अधिशेष कहते हैं।

qe: What is 'Blue Revolution' related to?
qh: 'नीली क्रांति' का संबंध किससे है?
e: Marine/Fisheries development. / मत्स्य पालन का विकास।

qe: What is 'Disguised Unemployment' mostly in?

e: This scheme provides financial support to youth and women to start new businesses in Bihar. / युवाओं और महिलाओं को नया उद्योग लगाने के लिए बिहार सरकार भारी वित्तीय मदद दे रही है।

qe: Which sector is Bihar's 'Saat Nischay Part-2' primarily focusing on for youth?

qe: In the Bihar Budget, what is 'Revenue Surplus'?

qe: Which criterion is used by the 15th Finance Commission with 15% weightage for horizontal devolution?

qe: Which Indian state has a separate 'Agriculture Budget' like Bihar?

qe: In Bihar Budget 2024-25, what is the allocated amount for 'Agriculture Roadmap'?
qh: बिहार बजट 2024-25 में 'कृषि रोडमैप' के लिए आवंटित राशि क्या है?

qe: Under the 15th Finance Commission, which state got the highest share in tax devolution?
qh: 15वें वित्त आयोग के तहत, टैक्स बंटवारे में किस राज्य को सबसे अधिक हिस्सा मिला?
e: Uttar Pradesh has the highest share (approx 17.9%), followed by Bihar (approx 10%). / अपनी बड़ी आबादी और क्षेत्रफल के कारण यूपी को सबसे ज्यादा हिस्सा मिलता है।

qe: In Bihar Budget terminology, what is 'Revenue Receipts'?
qh: बिहार बजट शब्दावली में 'राजस्व प्राप्तियां' क्या हैं?

qe: Which sector in Bihar contributes the most to its 'Own Tax Revenue'?
qh: बिहार के 'स्वयं के कर राजस्व' में कौन सा क्षेत्र सबसे अधिक योगदान देता है?
e: State GST is the primary source of Bihar's own tax revenue, reflecting the growing consumption in the state. / बिहार सरकार की अपनी टैक्स कमाई में सबसे बड़ा हिस्सा SGST का होता है।

qe: In the context of the Bihar Budget, what does 'Grants-in-aid' from the Center represent?
qh: बिहार बजट के संदर्भ में, केंद्र से मिलने वाला 'सहायता अनुदान' क्या दर्शाता है?
o: Non-repayable funds for specific development purposes
e: Grants are part of revenue receipts and unlike loans, the state does not have to pay them back. / यह वह पैसा है जो केंद्र सरकार बिहार को विकास के लिए देती है और इसे वापस नहीं करना पड़ता।

qe: What does a 'Current Account Deficit' (CAD) signify in terms of foreign exchange?
qh: विदेशी मुद्रा के संदर्भ में 'करंट अकाउंट घाटा' (CAD) क्या दर्शाता है?
o: The country has zero external debt
The country's total imports and payments exceed its total exports and receipts
The country is earning more than it is spending
The country is closed to international trade
e: A high CAD means there is a net outflow of foreign exchange, requiring capital inflows or borrowings to balance it. / उच्च CAD का अर्थ है कि विदेशी मुद्रा का शुद्ध बहिर्वाह हो रहा है, जिसे संतुलित करने के लिए निवेश या उधार की आवश्यकता होती है।

qe: What is the primary definition of 'Fiscal Policy'?
qh: 'राजकोषीय नीति' (Fiscal Policy) की प्राथमिक परिभाषा क्या है?
o: Policy related to money supply by RBI
Policy related to government revenue (taxes) and expenditure

qe: Before 2016-17, Indian government expenditure was classified into which two main categories?
qh: 2016-17 से पहले, भारत सरकार के खर्च को किन दो मुख्य श्रेणियों में वर्गीकृत किया गया था?
e: Plan expenditure was linked to five-year plans, while Non-Plan expenditure included interest payments, subsidies, and defense. / योजना व्यय पंचवर्षीय योजनाओं से जुड़ा था, जबकि गैर-योजना व्यय में ब्याज भुगतान, सब्सिडी और रक्षा शामिल थे।

qe: Which type of government receipt creates a liability or reduces assets (e.g., loans or disinvestment)?
qh: किस प्रकार की सरकारी प्राप्ति एक देनदारी पैदा करती है या संपत्ति को कम करती है (जैसे ऋण या विनिवेश)?
e: Capital receipts include borrowings and money raised from selling shares in PSUs, which either create debt or reduce government assets. / पूंजीगत प्राप्तियों में उधार और पीएसयू में शेयर बेचकर जुटाया गया पैसा शामिल है।

qe: Which tax is considered 'Direct Tax' because its burden cannot be shifted to others?
qh: किस कर को 'प्रत्यक्ष कर' माना जाता है क्योंकि इसका बोझ दूसरों पर नहीं डाला जा सकता है?
e: Direct taxes like Income Tax and Corporate Tax are paid directly by the person or firm on whom they are levied. / आयकर और कॉर्पोरेट कर जैसे प्रत्यक्ष कर सीधे उस व्यक्ति या फर्म द्वारा भुगतान किए जाते हैं जिन पर वे लगाए जाते हैं।

qe: The mechanism used by RBI to provide temporary loans to the government to meet mismatches in receipts and payments is called:
qh: प्राप्तियों और भुगतानों में बेमेल को पूरा करने के लिए सरकार को अस्थायी ऋण प्रदान करने के लिए आरबीआई द्वारा उपयोग किए जाने वाले तंत्र को क्या कहा जाता है?
e: WMA is a temporary loan facility provided by the RBI to the government for up to 90 days. / WMA केंद्र और राज्यों को नकदी के प्रवाह में अस्थायी बेमेल को दूर करने के लिए RBI द्वारा दी जाने वाली ऋण सुविधा है।

qe: What is the 'Cascading Effect' of taxes?

qe: GST (Goods and Services Tax) was introduced to replace which type of taxes?
qh: GST (वस्तु एवं सेवा कर) को किस प्रकार के करों को बदलने के लिए पेश किया गया था?

qe: Which body is responsible for making decisions on GST rates and exemptions in India?

e: The GST Council, headed by the Union Finance Minister, is the constitutional body that decides on all GST matters. / केंद्रीय वित्त मंत्री की अध्यक्षता वाली जीएसटी परिषद जीएसटी के सभी मामलों पर निर्णय लेती है।

qe: What is the primary characteristic of a 'Progressive Tax' system?

o: Tax rate increases as income increases
Tax rate decreases as income increases
Tax rate remains the same for everyone

qe: What happens to 'Exports' under the GST regime in India?

e: Exports are zero-rated under GST to make them competitive in the global market. / निर्यात को जीएसटी के तहत शून्य-रेटेड किया गया है ताकि वैश्विक बाजार में उनकी प्रतिस्पर्धा बनी रहे।

qe: The concept of 'Widening the Tax Base' refers to:

Increasing the number of people who fall under the tax net
e: Widening the tax base means bringing more people into the system of paying taxes, rather than just increasing the burden on existing taxpayers. / कर आधार को व्यापक बनाने का अर्थ है मौजूदा करदाताओं पर बोझ बढ़ाने के बजाय अधिक लोगों को कर भुगतान की प्रणाली में लाना।

qe: What significant change was made to the Rail Budget in 2017?

qe: Which committee recommended the merger of the Rail Budget with the Union Budget?
qh: किस समिति ने रेल बजट को केंद्रीय बजट में मिलाने की सिफारिश की थी?
e: The Bibek Debroy Committee of NITI Aayog recommended the merger to streamline the budgeting process and provide more financial autonomy to the railways. / नीति आयोग की बिबेक देबरॉय समिति ने बजट प्रक्रिया को सुव्यवस्थित करने के लिए विलय की सिफारिश की थी।

qe: What does 'Charged Expenditure' mean in the Indian Budget?

Expenditure on mobile charges for ministers
Expenditure that is not subject to voting in Parliament (e.g., salaries of the President, Judges)

qe: Why was the date of the Union Budget presentation moved from the last day of February to February 1st?
qh: केंद्रीय बजट पेश करने की तारीख फरवरी के आखिरी दिन से हटाकर 1 फरवरी क्यों कर दी गई?
o: To complete the legislative process before the start of the new financial year on April 1st

To avoid the heat of March

qe: What does the term 'Duty Drawback' mean for an exporter?
qh: एक निर्यात के लिए 'ड्यूटी ड्रॉबैक' (Duty Drawback) शब्द का क्या अर्थ है?

qe: What is 'Fiscal Deficit' and how is it related to 'Current Account Deficit' in the 'Twin Deficit' concept?
qh: 'राजकोषीय घाटा' क्या है और 'ट्विन डेफिसिट' (Twin Deficit) अवधारणा में यह करंट अकाउंट घाटे से कैसे संबंधित है?
o: When both the government's budget deficit and the country's trade deficit are high
When two different currencies have the same value
When a country has double the amount of gold
When the bank interest rate is doubled
e: Twin deficit refers to a situation where a country has both a high fiscal deficit (government overspending) and a high current account deficit. / ट्विन डेफिसिट उस स्थिति को संदर्भित करता है जहाँ देश का राजकोषीय घाटा और करंट अकाउंट घाटा दोनों अधिक होते हैं।

qe: What is a 'Tobin Tax' primarily designed to achieve?
qh: 'टोबिन टैक्स' (Tobin Tax) मुख्य रूप से क्या प्राप्त करने के लिए डिज़ाइन किया गया है?
o: To fund the education of poor children
To discourage short-term speculative capital flows and reduce currency volatility
To increase the tax on gold imports
e: A Tobin tax is a small tax on all foreign exchange transactions intended to penalize short-term currency speculation. / टोबिन टैक्स अल्पकालिक मुद्रा सट्टेबाजी को दंडित करने के लिए सभी विदेशी मुद्रा लेनदेन पर लगाया जाने वाला एक छोटा कर है।

qe: What constitutes 'External Debt' for a country like India?
qh: भारत जैसे देश के लिए 'बाह्य ऋण' (External Debt) में क्या शामिल होता है?

All types of foreign currency liabilities of the Central Govt, Indian companies, and residents
Only the loans taken by the common public from local banks
Only the taxes paid by NRIs
e: External debt includes all financial liabilities of the government, private corporations, and individuals to non-residents that are payable in foreign currency. / बाह्य ऋण में सरकार, निजी निगमों और व्यक्तियों की विदेशी मुद्रा में देय सभी वित्तीय देनदारियां शामिल हैं।

qe: What does the term 'Debt Servicing' primarily refer to in eco?
qh: अर्थशास्त्र में 'ऋण सेवा' (Debt Servicing) शब्द का प्राथमिक अर्थ क्या है?
o: Providing free banking services to people
Payment of the principal amount along with interest on the borrowed funds
Selling government assets to pay off debt
Increasing the tax rate for everyone
e: Debt servicing is the cash required to cover the repayment of interest and principal on a debt for a particular period. / ऋण सेवा वह नकदी है जो एक निश्चित अवधि के लिए ऋण पर ब्याज और मूलधन के पुनर्भुगतान के लिए आवश्यक होती है।

qe: The 'External Debt to GDP Ratio' is an important indicator of:
qh: 'बाह्य ऋण-जीडीपी अनुपात' किसका एक महत्वपूर्ण संकेतक है?
o: The amount of rainfall in a year
The total number of citizens in a country
The economic sustainability and sensitivity of a country's external debt
The gold reserves of a nation
e: This ratio measures the country's ability to produce and export enough to cover its foreign debt liabilities. / यह अनुपात अपने विदेशी ऋण देनदारियों को कवर करने के लिए पर्याप्त उत्पादन और निर्यात करने की देश की क्षमता को मापता है।

qe: What characterizes India's 'Public Debt' compared to many other developing nations?
qh: कई अन्य विकासशील देशों की तुलना में भारत के 'सार्वजनिक ऋण' की क्या विशेषता है?
o: A large majority (around 90%) is internal debt, owed to domestic residents and institutions
Most of it is owed to foreign countries
India only owes money in gold
e: India's public debt is dominated by internal debt (borrowed within the country), which provides more stability against exchange rate fluctuations. / भारत का सार्वजनिक ऋण आंतरिक ऋण (देश के भीतर से उधार) द्वारा हावी है, जो विनिमय दर के उतार-चढ़ाव के खिलाफ स्थिरता प्रदान करता है।

qe: Why is 'Internal Debt' considered safer than 'External Debt' for a government?
qh: सरकार के लिए 'आंतरिक ऋण' को 'बाह्य ऋण' से अधिक सुरक्षित क्यों माना जाता है?
o: Because internal debt doesn't need to be repaid
Because it does not involve foreign exchange risk and the government can print home currency to manage it
Because local people don't ask for interest
Because only farmers give internal debt
e: Internal debt is payable in local currency, reducing the risk of a crisis if the national currency depreciates against the dollar. / आंतरिक ऋण स्थानीय मुद्रा में देय होता है, जिससे मुद्रा के अवमूल्यन के मामले में संकट का जोखिम कम हो जाता है।

qe: What happens if a country uses its external borrowings for 'Consumption' instead of 'Investment'?
qh: यदि कोई देश अपने बाह्य उधार का उपयोग 'निवेश' के बजाय 'उपभोग' के लिए करता है तो क्या होता है?
o: The debt is automatically canceled by the World Bank
The country becomes very rich quickly
It creates a future burden as the debt doesn't generate income to pay back the interest
e: Borrowing for investment (like infrastructure) creates assets that help repay the debt, while borrowing for consumption leads to a debt trap. / निवेश के लिए उधार लेना संपत्ति बनाता है जो ऋण चुकाने में मदद करता है, जबकि उपभोग के लिए उधार लेना ऋण जाल की ओर ले जाता है।

qe: What is the role of the 'GST Network' (GSTN)?
qh: 'जीएसटी नेटवर्क' (GSTN) की क्या भूमिका है?
o: To provide the IT infrastructure for registration and returns
e: GSTN provides the massive technological portal required for GST implementation. / GSTN जीएसटी कार्यान्वयन के लिए तकनीकी पोर्टल प्रदान करता है।

qe: Which indicator should be closely monitored to prevent a Balance of Payments crisis?
qh: भुगतान संतुलन संकट को रोकने के लिए किस संकेतक की बारीकी से निगरानी की जानी चाहिए?
o: Number of holidays in a year
Amount of rainfall in a decade
Current Account Deficit (CAD) and Debt Service Ratio
e: A high CAD and an unsustainable debt-servicing burden are early warning signs that an economy might face a currency crisis. / एक उच्च CAD और ऋण चुकाने का अस्थिर बोझ चेतावनी के संकेत हैं कि अर्थव्यवस्था मुद्रा संकट का सामना कर सकती है।

qe: What is the primary objective of 'Fiscal Stimulus' packages provided by governments during a recession?
qh: मंदी के दौरान सरकारों द्वारा प्रदान किए जाने वाले 'राजकोषीय प्रोत्साहन' (Fiscal Stimulus) पैकेजों का प्राथमिक उद्देश्य क्या है?
o: To reduce the salaries of employees
To boost aggregate demand and economic activity through increased government spending or tax cuts
To close down all private companies
To stop the import of petroleum
e: Fiscal stimulus aims to revive the economy by putting more money in the hands of consumers and businesses to encourage spending. / इसका उद्देश्य सरकारी खर्च बढ़ाकर या करों में कटौती करके अर्थव्यवस्था में मांग को फिर से जीवित करना है।

qe: What is the goal of 'Fiscal Consolidation' as mentioned in the text?
qh: पाठ में बताए अनुसार 'राजकोषीय सुदृढ़ीकरण' (Fiscal Consolidation) का लक्ष्य क्या है?
o: Increasing the government's borrowing to infinity
Reducing the fiscal deficit to a sustainable level (e.g., 3% of GDP)
e: Fiscal consolidation involves policies aimed at reducing government deficits and debt accumulation. / राजकोषीय सुदृढ़ीकरण में सरकारी घाटे और ऋण संचय को कम करने के उद्देश्य से नीतियां शामिल हैं।
